response.sql: WITH client_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 as region, c.district_id, COUNT(c.client_id) as client_count FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3, c.district_id), regional_stats AS (SELECT region, district_id, client_count, SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) as region_total_clients FROM client_counts) SELECT region, AVG(client_count) as avg_clients_per_district, AVG(CAST(client_count AS FLOAT) / region_total_clients) as avg_client_share FROM regional_stats GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

assumptions.assumption: In 'each district's share of clients', the denominator 'total of the counts over all districts' refers to all districts within the region, not across the entire database

alternatives.interpretation: The share denominator could be the total client count across all districts in the entire database
alternatives.sql: WITH total_clients_all AS (SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) as total_clients FROM client c), client_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 as region, c.district_id, COUNT(c.client_id) as client_count FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3, c.district_id), regional_stats AS (SELECT cc.region, cc.district_id, cc.client_count, tca.total_clients FROM client_counts cc CROSS JOIN total_clients_all tca) SELECT region, AVG(client_count) as avg_clients_per_district, AVG(CAST(client_count AS FLOAT) / total_clients) as avg_client_share FROM regional_stats GROUP BY region ORDER BY region
